fa_paper.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness (Dao, Fu, Ermon, Rudra, Ré)
fa_paper.text: atlas/papers/flashattention/paper.txt (arXiv HTML full text https://arxiv.org/html/2205.14135v2 converted to text by discover_paper.py's companion extractor; display math kept as the HTML alttext LaTeX)
fa_paper.anchor_convention: fa:§N (section), fa:algN:LK (Algorithm N, line K as numbered in the box), fa:thmN / fa:propN (theorem, proposition), fa:tableN / fa:figN (as printed), fa:eqN (the paper's own equation numbers, which exist only for Appendix B Eqs. 1-6; main-body displays are unnumbered and are anchored by section, e.g. fa:§3.1:softmax-decomp), fa:§C:thmN-proof / fa:§C:propN-proof (a proof paragraph in Appendix C), fa:§B.5 / fa:§E.5 (appendix subsections)
fa_paper.note: No PDF was downloaded; page numbers are therefore not recorded. Every quote with this source is checked verbatim (whitespace- and punctuation-insensitive) against paper.txt by discover_paper.py --check; discovered.json carries the result. Tables are transcribed from the HTML table cells, so values are as printed.

lecture_05.title: CS336 Spring 2026, Lecture 5: GPUs (FlashAttention on slides 50-54, memory hierarchy on 10-12)
lecture_05.note: Gives the course's teaching order for FlashAttention (tiling -> online softmax -> forward pass), to be compared with the paper's order.
